Commentary.Commentary: The rain gods weren't ready to stay away for this game and the inevitable happened. The rain gods had the final say in this match. Both the teams go home with 1 point in their kitty. A blessing in disguise perhaps for West Indies as they now end with 7 points and India Women need to win their clash against South Africa Women. If they fail to do so, West Indies Women go through. If India wins then West Indies Women will pray that England lose a game. South Africa won't be much worried as they have now booked their semi final berth. We will be back on 25th March, Friday for yet another clash where Australia Women taken on Bangladesh Women. That match will begin at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous day). But you know the drill right? The build-up will begin much in advance. Do join us for that. Meanwhile, England Women vs Pakistan Women is going on right now where the former needs only 106 runs to win to strengthen their position in the points table. Do switch tabs to enjoy the coverage from that game. Until then, ta da!

Stafanie Taylor, the West Indies Women skipper, is up for a chat. She says that she is not happy as the game could not go on. Adds, it is also something which isn’t in their control. Mentions that the bowlers were on the money. Also says that Henry really enjoy bowling against South Africa, because she just keep picking up wickets against the opposition. Informs that they will keep the popcorn ready to watch the game between India and South Africa. On the top 4 qualification, she says that it is not in their control, but will hope it goes their way.

Sune Luus, the South Africa Women skipper, is up for a chat. She says that she is really excited and obviously really happy to be in the semifinals. Tells that with the rain today it wasn't ideal to wait and then go out there. Mentions that they didn't have the best of starts but there are still a lot of batters who'd want to get some runs, Lizelle Lee at the top and our number 3 as well. States that Mignon played well today and is one of our most important batters. Adds that hopefully, she'll continue that form going forward. On asked if Masabata Klaas would be fit for the semis, she says that she should be fine. Informs that it's been a dream for them for so long but we need to get through the semifinals.

With the weather not relenting, the final conclusion is that the match has been CALLED OFF. Not the end any team would’ve wanted after getting on to the field after a four-hour delay. Wellington was not a friendly place to play cricket in the morning, with persistent rainfall. The game had to be reduced to 26 overs each, but even this was too much to ask for from the rain gods.

Update - 8.36 am IST (3.06 am GMT) - Both the umpires converge and have decided that the drizzle is too heavy for the players to continue. The players have been asked to walk off the field and the covers come in as well. Let's hope we are not in for another long delay.

Three runs now! This is solid running. 15 runs come off the first five balls. It is looped up, outside off. Mignon du Preez steers it down to third man. The batters pick three before the fielder cuts it out. Stafanie Taylor was a little slow during her chase.
FOUR! Third boundary on the trot! Mignon du Preez is not holding back. Flighted, full, wide outside off. Mignon du Preez drives it through covers. Four.
FOUR! Mignon du Preez is on a roll. Shortish, outside off. Mignon du Preez guides it down to third man for another boundary.
FOUR! Boundaries coming in at a good rate for South Africa Women. A full toss now, on off. Mignon du Preez whips it across mid on for a boundary. 50 up for South Africa Women.
Floated, full, outside off. Mignon du Preez eases it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Good shot! Width on offer, outside off. Marizanne Kapp stands tall and cuts it through point for a boundary. Chinelle Henry is not happy with that.
Full and outside off, Mignon du Preez leans and drives it to cover. Karishma Ramharack there misfields and allows a single.
On a good length, around off. Mignon du Preez taps it to the off side.
Good-length ball, on off. Mignon du Preez covers the line and pats it back to the bowler.
Full and on off, driven back to the bowler.
Length ball, outside off. Mignon du Preez hangs back and cuts it through covers. She hares back for the second run and gets it easily in the end.
Length ball, on middle. Mignon du Preez tucks it to square leg and retains the strike with a single.
Full and outside off, Marizanne Kapp drives it through covers for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Mignon du Preez goes for the cut shot again but mistimes it. She gets an under edge and the ball rolls back to the keeper who fumbles to collect and allows a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Back of a length again, outside off. Mignon du Preez cuts it hard and beats the point fielder. The ball races away to the fence in a flash.
Back of a length, on off. Mignon du Preez hops and punches it towards cover-point.
Fullish, outside off. Mignon du Preez leans and drives it through covers. Nice-looking shot and she gets two for it.
Outside off, on a length. Marizanne Kapp shoulders arms.
On off, Marizanne Kapp drives it back to the left of the bowler. It rolls behind her and goes to mid off.
Fuller in length, on middle. Marizanne Kapp drives it back onto the other side of the stumps. Chinelle Henry dives that side but does not get her fingers on it.
Fullish, outside off. Marizanne Kapp shoulders arms.
WIDE! Length ball, well outside off. Marizanne Kapp chases after it but then lets it go. Wided.
On a length, on middle. Marizanne Kapp defends it to mid-wicket.
So, 4 bowlers will be allowed to bowl 5 overs while 1 will be allowed to bowl 6 overs. This is the revised schedule for the reduced encounter.
Good-length ball, attacking the stumps. Marizanne Kapp blocks it back onto the pitch.
FOUR! A boundary off the last ball but it's still a good over from Shamilia Connell. Just 4 runs from it. Full and on the pads, Mignon du Preez flicks it to deep square leg for a welcome boundary.
Fuller, outside off. Mignon du Preez again leaves it for the keeper to collect.
Outside off, on a length. Mignon du Preez lets it sail through.
Good-length ball, outside off. Mignon du Preez watches the ball closely and shoulders arms.
On a good length, outside off. Mignon du Preez lets it be.
Good-length ball, outside off, extra bounce on that one. Mignon du Preez looks to cut it away but fails to connect.
Full and on middle and leg, Mignon du Preez drives it to mid on for a single.
Slower ball, on the stumps. Mignon du Preez taps it on the leg side.
Back of a length, on off. Mignon du Preez punches it through covers for a couple of runs.

OUT! CAUGHT! South Africa Women are falling apart here. The pressure was building and as a result, another batter holes out. Length ball, outside off. Tazmin Brits gets low and looks to heave it across the line. She only manages to get a top edge though. The ball goes in the air towards the cover region where Karishma Ramharack takes a simple catch. This is absolute carnage from West Indies Women. Chinelle Henry is on fire as she gets her third wicket now. Marizanne Kapp is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Karishma Ramharack b Chinelle Henry

Commentary.Commentary: On a good length again, Tazmin Brits clips it on the leg side.
Good-length ball, on off, angling in. Tazmin Brits pushes it back to the bowler.
Full length, outside off. Mignon du Preez blocks it out solidly.
Length, on the stumps. Mignon du Preez blocks it to point.
On middle and leg, blocked back to the bowler.
Full length, outside off. Mignon du Preez pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! EDGY! A length ball, outside off. Mignon du Preez gets it racing down to third man off the outside edge.
Outside off, left alone.
DROPPED! This drop in a couple of overs. It is full, outside off. Mignon du Preez tries to push it away. The ball goes to right of Deandra Dottin. They take a single.
Mignon du Preez walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust. This time it is the South Africa Women skipper who walks back on a timid score. Back of a length, outside off. This one holds into the pitch. Sune Luus is a tad early into her cut shot. She works it aerially towards point. Stafanie Taylor dives in front to grab the ball with both hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Stafanie Taylor b Chinelle Henry

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, left alone.

DROPPED! West Indies Women creating a lot of chances here. Good-length ball, outside off. Tazmin Brits tries to defend it out. The ball takes the outside edge and flies towards Deandra Dottin at second slip. Although this time she fails to grab onto it. It rolls behind and the batters take a single.
Good length, outside off. Tazmin Brits fails to punch it away.
WIDE! Length ball, wide outside off, shaping away. Brits leaves it alone. Wide called.
Sune Luus is off the mark. A length ball, on off. Luus pushes it to point for a single.
Full length, outside off. Brits tries to heave it away but misses.
Put down! A length ball, outside off. Tazmin Brits looks to defend it out. The ball goes towards first slip off the outside edge. Hayley Matthews dives to her left but is unable to grab the ball.
The skipper, Sune Luus walks in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Karishma Ramharack holds on to the catch on her second attempt. South Africa Women lose their second wicket in no time. This is was a reduced over match does to you. It forces you to keep finding the boundaries. It is full, on off. Lizelle Lee heaves it away across the line. The ball takes the top-edge and flies high in the air. It goes towards mid-wicket. Karishma Ramharack settles under it, fumbles but ends up pouching the ball eventually.
Commentary.Howout: c Karishma Ramharack b Shamilia Connell

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, outside off, it bounces off the deck. Lizelle Lee tries to go after it but pulls her blade back just in time.
Length, outside off. Lee defends it to point.
FOUR! Lee continues to dominate the leg side. It is full, on off. Lizelle Lee shuffles across a bit and heaves it across the line, over mid-wicket for a boundary.
BEATEN! Good length, outside off. Tazmin Brits tries to chase it but misses. A wicket taking over by Chinelle Henry comes to an end.
Tazmin Brits is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Deandra Dottin continues to impress in this World Cup. West Indies Women get the early wicket that they were hunting for. Laura Wolvaardt goes back on a timid score. It is short, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt cuts it hard to the left of point. Deandra Dottin there dives to that side and grabs the ball with her right hand. An incredible catch to send back the danger woman.
Commentary.Howout: c Deandra Dottin b Chinelle Henry

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, wide outside off. Lizelle Lee throws her blade at it. The ball flies towards third man off the outer half. They take a single.
Length ball, angled into the pads. Laura Wolvaardt flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Laura Wolvaardt gets off the mark now! Back of a length, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt punches it through point for a brace. This is really good running.
Length ball, on off. Laura Wolvaardt blocks it back to the bowler.
Chinelle Henry will operate from the other end.
FOUR! Lizelle Lee gets the first boundary of the innings. Back of a length, on off. Lizelle Lee swivels on the back foot and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Shortish, outside off. Lizelle Lee tries to chase it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
WIDE! Full, wide outside off. Shapes away outside the tramline. Wide called.
Back of a length, outside off. Lizelle Lee looks to cut it away but misses. Hardly any foot movement this time.
Fuller, wide outside off. Lee leaves it alone for the keeper.
Full length, on the fourth stump. Lee drives it to cover on the front foot.
Good length, wide outside off. Lizelle Lee shoulders her arms to it.
WIDE! Full length, angled down leg. Lizelle Lee leaves it alone. Wide called. Shamilia Connell starts with a loosener.

We are done with the pre-match formalities. The players now stride out to the middle and take their respective fielding positions. Laura Wolvaardt and Lizelle Lee are the openers for South Africa Women. Shamilia Connell to start the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...

We are set for the action. Both the teams stride out to the middle and get lined-up for their respective national anthems. First, the national anthem of West Indies will be played followed by South Africa's.

PITCH REPORT - Mel Jones says that the clouds are still hovering around and there is no wind. Lisa Sthalekar mentions that there is a bit of moisture and the spinners will find it difficult to spin the ball. States that the bowlers will need to tighten up their lines to get some movement off the deck and the conditions will not help the batters either.
Sune Luus, the skipper of South Africa Women, is in for a chat. She says, they would have bowled first as well, but they wouldn’t mind batting first. Mentions that they have a single change.

Stafanie Taylor, the West Indies Women skipper, is in for a chat. She says that they will bowl first as the pitch has been covered for a while. Mentions that they are not bothered about the end and are just focusing on the process. Tells that they will learn from the Pakistan loss and not repeat in this game. Informs that they have three changes to the side.

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Lizelle Lee, Laura Wolvaardt, Tazmin Brits (In for Lara Goodall), Sune Luus (C), Mignon du Preez, Marizanne Kapp, Chloe Tryon, Trisha Chetty (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka, Tumi Sekhukhune.

West Indies Women (Playing XI) - Deandra Dottin, Hayley Matthews, Stafanie Taylor (C), Shemaine Campbelle (WK), Chedean Nation, Kycia Knight, Chinelle Henry, Afy Fletcher, Rashada Williams (In for Aaliyah Alleyne), Karishma Ramharack (In for Anisa Mohammed), Shamilia Connell (In for Shakera Selman).
TOSS - The coin goes up and it lands in favour of West Indies Women. They have opted to bowl first. This will now be a 26-over game.

Update - 7.03 am IST(1.33 am GMT) - We finally have some good news! It has stopped raining and the covers are off as well. Toss will take place at 7.25 am IST (1.55 am GMT) and the play will start at 7.45 am IST (2.15 am GMT) if weather permits.

Update - 6 am IST (12.30 am GMT) - Well, the umpires were out for the inspection. One of the cover was on its way out. We were inching closer to the action but the rain gods showed no mercy. The persistent drizzle is back. There is no sign of wind as well, which can be a concern. Will we see a ball being bowled before the cut-off time for a T20 i.e. 0838 IST (0308 GMT)? But as the wait continues here, the second game of the double-header is about to start. Do switch tabs to check it out. Do not forget to keep you eye out on this game though.

Update - 5.01 am IST (11.31 pm GMT, previous day) - The outfield is still very wet and the covers are still intact. It is drizzling but the intensity is very low and the umpires will have an inspection at 5.30 am IST (12 am GMT). We have also started to lose overs now. Stay tuned for more updates!

Update - 4.05 am IST (10.35 pm GMT, previous day) - Something to cheer about! There are no signs of rain at the moment but the covers are still in place. They might come off and if we are lucky, we could get the action soon. The wait continues...

The rain just spices things up in this Women's World Cup. South Africa Women would not mind if the game gets washed out. They will happily take a point and become the second team to qualify for the semis. West Indies Women despartely need a game to happen, if they are to keep their top 4 hopes alive. Also, this washout means that India, West Indies and England will fight for the final two spots with New Zealand, Bangladesh and Pakistan knocked out.

UPDATE 0300 IST (2130 GMT, previous day) - Unfortunately, the weather hasn't been kind in Wellington. It has been drizzling since the morning. The ground is covered up. Hopefully, we get enough game time to squeeze in a result. Also, the toss has been delayed. It was inevitable to be honest.

On the other hand, West Indies started their campaign really well with close wins but have had some contrasting results after that. They lost their previous encounter against Pakistan and are now on the verge of losing out a position in the top four in the points table. They will look to now beat South Africa and boost their semi finals hopes. Stick around for toss and team news.

The Women in Green are coming off a defeat from the hands of the table-toppers Australia in their previous fixture but have managed to win all their remaining fixtures so far. However, a win here might just propel their chances of making it to the semi-finals. However, they face a resourceful West Indies side who have a knack for springing an upset.

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of match 23 of the Women's Cricket World Cup where South Africa Women will take on West Indies Women. Both teams are coming on the back of a loss from their previous encounter and with valuable 2 points up for grabs, an entertaining game beckons in Wellington.
... MATCH DAY ...
